test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: It can be inferred from the passage that:

options.text: all cartoonists get ideas from newspapers
making cartoons is a combination of art and wit
any good artist can become a cartoonist
creativity can be acquired in institutes

solution:
The correct answer is "**making cartoons is a combination of art and wit**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The theme of the given passage is about the** profession of cartoonists and what makes a good cartoonist.**
 
• In the last paragraph, Uday Shankar states that basics, like **drawing and sketching**, can be learned in an art college, and are important skills,
 
• The last line suggests that one's talent at sketching should not be confused with becoming a successful cartoonist. One needs to have **creativity **and **humor **as well to flourish in the career of a cartoonist and these cannot be taught to someone.
 
• Therefore, it can be summed up that **"making cartoons is a combination of art and wit**"

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**
